title: Boosting LLM Reasoning via Human-Inspired Reward Shaping
abstract: arXiv:2602.04265v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs). However, existing reward formulations typically treat exploration and consolidation as a monolithic process, resulting in entangled stage-wise learning dynamics. This contradicts the natural learning behavior of human learners. In human learning, individuals adopt distinct behavioral patterns toward mastered versus unfamiliar problems. When confronting unmastered challenges, humans prioritize broad exploration to seek viable solutions. By contrast, for well-mastered problems, they focus instead on reasoning condensation and knowledge abstraction to distill concise underlying principles. translated_title: 通过人类启发的奖励塑形提升大语言模型推理能力
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）已成为提升大语言模型（LLM）推理能力的一种有前景的范式。然而，现有的奖励设计通常将探索与巩固视为一个单一的整体过程，导致分阶段的学习动态相互纠缠，这与人类学习者的自然学习行为相悖。在人类学习中，个体对已掌握的问题与陌生的问题会采取截然不同的行为模式：面对尚未掌握的挑战时，人类会优先进行广泛探索以寻求可行的解决方案；相比之下，对于已经熟练掌握的问题，他们则专注于推理的凝练与知识的抽象，以提炼出简洁的底层原理。受这一差距的启发，我们提出了T2T（Thickening-to-Thinning，由厚到薄），一个受人类学习过程启发的动态奖励框架。具体而言，它实现了一个双阶段机制：(1) 在回答错误时……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出受人类学习过程启发的T2T动态奖励框架，通过“由厚到薄”的双阶段机制，让模型在未掌握的问题上鼓励广泛探索、在已掌握的问题上鼓励推理凝练与知识抽象，从而克服现有RLVR奖励设计将探索与巩固混为一谈的缺陷，提升大语言模型的推理能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces T2T (Thickening-to-Thinning), a human-learning-inspired dynamic reward framework for RLVR that encourages broad exploration on unmastered problems and reasoning condensation on mastered ones, thereby boosting LLM reasoning beyond existing monolithic reward designs.
